name: SIQ - Video Split
description: Premium split-layout video section with video on one side and editorial content on the other. Features animated circular play button with progress ring, custom poster images, multiple layout options (video left/right/full), muted autoplay mode, scroll-triggered reveal, ambient glow, and glassmorphism cards. Blocks for multiple video slides with scroll-based transitions. 70+ customization options.
author: SectionIQ
